steps.note: Traced distance events, renderer radius, reset paths and existing CSS zoom; verified panel positioning in Chromium.

steps.title: architect
steps.note: Compared two renderer interfaces and selected the dedicated distance input after independent review.

steps.title: implement
steps.note: Connected sensing callback to renderer; typecheck, 19 focused tests and build passed. Targeted native browser layout probe passed.

steps.title: report
steps.note: Documented behavior, reproducible checks, final synthetic screenshots, hashes, design review and remaining physical-camera gate. Working-tree implementation complete.
